description: This file implements a local cache layer for read receipts in Mattermost, including cache invalidation, retrieval, and update methods for read receipts associated with posts and users.

classes.name: LocalCacheReadReceiptStore
classes.description: A cache layer for read receipts, providing methods for cache invalidation, retrieval, and updates.

methods.name: handleClusterInvalidateReadReceipts
methods.description: Handles cluster message to invalidate read receipts cache.

methods.name: ClearCaches
methods.description: Clears all read receipt related caches and updates cache invalidation metrics.

methods.name: InvalidateReadReceiptForPostsCache
methods.description: Invalidates caches related to a specific post's read receipts.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a read receipt for a user and post, then invalidates related caches.

methods.name: DeleteByPost
methods.description: Deletes all read receipts for a specific post and invalidates caches.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a read receipt and invalidates related caches.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates a read receipt and invalidates related caches.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a read receipt from cache or underlying store, updating cache if needed.

methods.name: GetByPost
methods.description: Retrieves all read receipts for a post, using cache if available.

methods.name: GetUnreadCountForPost
methods.description: Retrieves unread count for a post, using cache if available.
